data.gender_notes: Kaaba is used as a neutral name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Kaaba is the holiest site in Islam, located in Mecca, Saudi Arabia. It is the center of the Islamic world and the direction of prayer for Muslims. The Kaaba is believed to have been built by Prophet Ibrahim and his son Ismail, and it is the site of the annual Hajj pilgrimage. The name Kaaba carries the meaning “House of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kaaba usually hope their child will grow to embody house of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unity and devotion to Allah.
data.etymology: Kaaba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “House of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kaaba total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The Kaaba represents the spiritual and cultural connection of over 1.8 billion Muslims around the world. It is a symbol of unity, as people from all races, ethnicities, and backgrounds come together to perform the pilgrimage to Mecca and pay their respects to the Kaaba. It is also a symbol of the rich history and traditions of the Islamic faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The Kaaba is considered the House of God in Islam, and it is believed that worshipping at the Kaaba brings one closer to Allah. The circumambulation of the Kaaba during the Hajj pilgrimage is a powerful symbol of the submission and devotion of Muslims to Allah. The Kaaba is also believed to be the destination of the first human beings, Adam and Eve, and it is the place where they were honored and forgiven by Allah. Overall, the Kaaba represents the central tenants of Islam - faith, submission, and devotion to Allah.
